title: 00 — Intake And Migrate (Atoms)
system_instructions: You are preparing to implement or update a single Atom in @vsk/ui-kit.
Communicate with the human developer/designer in Russian (RU), but keep code identifiers, file paths, shell commands, and other technical literals in English to reduce token usage.
Do NOT install or upgrade any packages. Use the workspace stack: Angular ^20.3.x, Storybook ^10.0.6, Taiga 4.16.0.
Design inputs come from Figma 'Copy as SVG' and 'Copy as code CSS (all layers)'.
Raw CSS must stay in `llm_current_task_context`, never committed to story assets.
goal: Auto-gather existing task context for a single atom, propose an English slug `<atom-name>`, and migrate all ad-hoc inputs into `llm_current_task_context/atoms/<atom-name>/`.

roles.agent: Analyze existing inputs and prepare a clean working context for the atom.
roles.developer: Approve or adjust the atom slug, moved resources, and missing inputs.
roles.designer: Optionally confirm the mapping between Figma resources and the chosen atom name.

inputs_expected: Optional: existing files anywhere under `llm_current_task_context` (may include non-canonical folders like `llm_current_task_context/кнопка`).
Optional: russian human-readable component name (for Storybook title/docs).

actions.description: Propose an English kebab-case slug `<atom-name>` for the atom (e.g. `button`, `input-text`). If a slug is already agreed, reuse it.
human_checklist: Does `<atom-name>` uniquely and clearly describe this atom in English?
Does the Russian name (if any) match the intent of the English slug?
Is the slug consistent with existing atoms naming (kebab-case, no ambiguous abbreviations)?

actions.description: Ensure canonical temp folders exist for this atom.
Scan the entire `llm_current_task_context` tree for any existing resources relevant to this atom (including non-canonical folders).
Move relevant CSS and media files into the canonical atom temp folders without overwriting existing files.

migration_rules.notes: Record each move in `notes.md` as `from → to`.

human_checklist: Review the list of files the agent plans to move from ad-hoc folders (e.g. `llm_current_task_context/кнопка`).
Confirm that each CSS/SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF belongs to this atom.
If some files belong to a different atom or organism, instruct the agent where to keep them instead.

actions.description: Summarize what is available and what is missing for this atom.
human_checklist: Does the summary accurately reflect all available SVG/CSS/PNG/JPG/PDF resources?
Are the listed Figma links correct for this atom?
Is the `missingInputs` list accurate and minimal (no redundant questions)?

acceptance_criteria: All relevant CSS and media inputs for this atom have been migrated into the canonical folders or explicitly left elsewhere with justification.
Slug `<atom-name>` is confirmed by a human.
context.json and notes.md are written and approved.
next_step_prompt: Use `docs/prompts/atoms/01-extract-figma-artifacts.md` with `llm_current_task_context/atoms/<atom-name>/` as the working context.
